title: P16-B Strategic ReasoningBrief — deterministic advisory contract
description: P16-B: src/pair/reasoning-brief.ts — ReasoningBriefService.briefFor composes the Strategic ReasoningBrief DETERMINISTICALLY from BrainContextService.contextFor (ONE read path: owner gate, scope, read budget, nested-budget refusal, fail-closed strict reads inherited; RB5/RB9). facts[] carry provenance tiers + section names — tier derives from the context's OWN integrity notes (KPI_PROGRESS_UNPROVEN:<id>/BUDGET_LEDGER_UNPROVEN), NOT the cockpit obsOk flag which conflates 'observation composed' with 'claims re-proven' (R1-M3; RB2/RB11). brief_digest pins canonical content only: asof/actor excluded, reasoner gates excluded (receipt currency is clock-derived), AUTO_POLICY facts digested as volatile-stripped projections (effective/expiry_pending stay visible in value) — verified stable across a REAL policy expiry instant while DISABLED row state moves it (R1-M1; RB10). Hypothesis/option gating uses canonical row fields only (state/configured/halt — never effective/expiry_pending). Binding truth: null+obsError → UNVERIFIED 'unobservable' never 'absent' — no PRE_DECOMPOSITION hypothesis, no INITIALIZE/PRIORITIZE options under observation_error (R1-M6 + brain-context BINDING_UNOBSERVABLE label; RB11). Terminal → zero options (RB3). options name existing authority_channels only. reasoner = BOTH canonical gates in cycle order: resolveCeoModelTransport THEN assertCeoModelUsable, IntegrityError mapped to UNRESOLVED/UNQUALIFIED+failure_code, non-IntegrityError propagates fail-closed (R1-M4/M8; RB7). BRIEF_TRUNCATED markers appended after caps — never truncated away (R1-M2; RB12). Expected gaps exact-matched (no prefix smuggle; R1-M5). ZERO writes (hash-footprint RB6); ADVISORY_ONLY; no second authority. Stacked on P16-A; CEO wiring is P16-C.
